AGENTS.md now requires short current plans for substantial work, documentation/examples updated alongside implementation, current status linked to dated evidence, and real-daemon Playwright checks for affected UI workflows. Detailed instructions remain in linked guides; the managed user-project template is unchanged.

Documentation checks and the full local gate passed: 255 Rust, 137 JavaScript and 12 Python tests. Evidence: progress/2026-09-30-agent-workflow-guidance.md. No application behavior, scope, priority or acceptance status changed.
